In 2000, the total population was 91.85 million, those aged 0-14 accounted for 24.17%, those aged 15-64 accounted for 69.78%, and those aged 65 and above accounted for 6.05%; in 2010, the total population was 104.30 million, those aged 0-14 accounted for 16.89%, those aged 15-64 accounted for 76.36%, and those aged 65 and above accounted for 6.75%. It can thus be seen that the proportion of the child population aged 0-14 decreased significantly, the proportion of the working-age population aged 15-64 increased, and the proportion of the population aged 65 and above increased slightly. Reasoning: the question stem states that the dependency ratio is the ratio of the non-working-age population to the working-age population. In the table, the proportion of the child population declined and the proportion of the working-age population rose, indicating that the child dependency burden declined and the support capacity of the working population strengthened. When school-age children decrease relatively, educational resources can be allocated more centrally to each child, and each child may receive more educational investment; therefore this change may be beneficial to the improvement of the level of compulsory education.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的表格：比较2000年和2010年广东省各年龄段人口占比，发现0—14岁少儿人口比重由24.17%降至16.89%，15—64岁劳动年龄人口比重由69.78%升至76.36%。再结合题干给出的抚养比定义判断，少儿非劳动年龄人口相对劳动年龄人口减少，少儿抚养负担下降。最后把少儿抚养压力减轻与教育资源配置联系起来：适龄儿童相对减少、劳动人口支撑能力增强，单位儿童可获得的教育投入和资源可能增加，因此这种变化可能有利于义务教育水平的提高。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：表格为广东省两次全国人口普查统计表，列出2000年和2010年的总人口及各年龄段占总人口比重。2000年总人口为9185万人，0—14岁占24.17%，15—64岁占69.78%，65岁及以上占6.05%；2010年总人口为10430万人，0—14岁占16.89%，15—64岁占76.36%，65岁及以上占6.75%。由此可见，0—14岁少儿人口比重明显下降，15—64岁劳动年龄人口比重上升，65岁及以上人口比重略有上升。推理：题干说明抚养比是非劳动年龄人口与劳动年龄人口数之比。表中少儿人口比重下降、劳动年龄人口比重上升，说明少儿抚养负担下降，劳动人口的支撑能力增强。适龄儿童相对减少时，教育资源可以更集中地分配到每个儿童身上，单位儿童可能获得更多教育投入，因此这种变化可能有利于义务教育水平的提高。
